item.title: Keep patched: N-able N-central: Static Code Injection
item.description:
N-able N-central: RCE · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 2026.3.1.14

First step: Update N-able N-central to 2026.3.1.14 or later.

N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-86218
